summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea and Plausible CE on private networks with companion databases and loopback-only ports, via guarded agent verbs (KD-040). App backup and restore with typed in-container database dumps, and S3 provider presets with a real write/read/delete test (KD-043). Migrations 0010-0012 are additive (app_port; app health tables; restore_points.manifest). Also: OS package updates, an update notice, app health alerts (KD-042).
